title: Aquastop Hose Fault
shortDescription: The aquastop safety hose has triggered or its sensor is faulty.
fullDescription: AEG dishwasher error E12 indicates aquastop hose triggered or sensor short. The control halts the wash program and displays the fault on the timer LEDs or digital display. Resolution depends on isolating the component and replacing as needed.

causes.cause: Aquastop hose triggered or sensor short

symptoms: E12 indicated by blinking lights or display
Door interlock may stay engaged briefly

fixSteps.title: Cancel and drain
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the program key for 3 seconds to cancel; the unit will attempt to drain.

fixSteps.title: Inspect filters and hoses
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the bottom filter assembly, clean it, and check the drain hose for kinks.

fixSteps.title: Test component
fixSteps.instruction: Pull the dishwasher out, remove the kick panel, and test the suspected part with a multimeter against the AEG tech sheet.

whenToCallPro: For E12 caused by sealed components or PCB failure, contact AEG authorized service. Built-in dishwasher removal requires shutting off plumbing and electrical safely.

faq.q: Why is my AEG dishwasher beeping continuously?
faq.a: Active error codes trigger continuous tones until acknowledged. Press cancel to silence.

faq.q: Where is the AEG service plate?
faq.a: On the inside of the door, on the right edge near the latch.

title: Wash Motor Triac Short
shortDescription: The wash motor triac on the control board is shorted.
fullDescription: AEG dishwasher error E31 indicates control triac failure. The control halts the wash program and displays the fault on the timer LEDs or digital display. Resolution depends on isolating the component and replacing as needed.
symptoms: E31 indicated by blinking lights or display
Door interlock may stay engaged briefly

fixSteps.title: Cancel and drain
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the program key for 3 seconds to cancel; the unit will attempt to drain.

fixSteps.title: Inspect filters and hoses
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the bottom filter assembly, clean it, and check the drain hose for kinks.

fixSteps.title: Test component
fixSteps.instruction: Pull the dishwasher out, remove the kick panel, and test the suspected part with a multimeter against the AEG tech sheet.

whenToCallPro: For E31 caused by sealed components or PCB failure, contact AEG authorized service. Built-in dishwasher removal requires shutting off plumbing and electrical safely.

faq.q: Why is my AEG dishwasher beeping continuously?
faq.a: Active error codes trigger continuous tones until acknowledged. Press cancel to silence.

faq.q: Where is the AEG service plate?
faq.a: On the inside of the door, on the right edge near the latch.
